The large reserve has stabilized sand hills, chalk and limestone, and a variety of animals, as well as several heritage sites from the War of Independence. Hikers in the area are invited to visit the Agur Sands reserve, Hurvat Halutza and Rehovot BaNegev, Shivta National Park and other points of interest.
